from collections import Counter
D1=[[8]*19 for _ in range(10)]
D1[1][0:6]=[3]*6; D1[1][12:16]=[2]*4
D1[3][2:10]=[3]*8; D1[5][14:18]=[3]*4; D1[6][5:8]=[3]*3
O1=[[3,3,3],[3,2,0]]
D2=[[5]*10 for _ in range(10)]
D2[1][0:4]=[3]*4; D2[3][1:3]=[2]*2; D2[4][6:9]=[2]*3; D2[7][4:8]=[3]*4
O2=[[3,3,2],[2,0,0]]
T=[[0]*10 for _ in range(15)]
T[1][1:5]=[3]*4; T[3][2:8]=[2]*6; T[7][5:9]=[3]*4; T[9][5:7]=[2]*2; T[11][1:3]=[3]*2; T[13][4:8]=[2]*4

def transform(grid):
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    bars=[]
    for row in grid:
        i=0
        while i<len(row):
            if row[i]==bg:
                i+=1
                continue
            color=row[i]
            while i<len(row) and row[i]==color:
                i+=1
            bars.append(color)
    cells=sorted(bars, reverse=True)[:6]
    cells += [0]*(6-len(cells))
    return [cells[:3],cells[3:]]
print(transform(D1), transform(D1)==O1)
print(transform(D2), transform(D2)==O2)
print(transform(T))
